webgl-page-transitions-with-threejs.author: jonas-kl
webgl-page-transitions-with-threejs.body: The `uCover` trick finally fixed my stretched thumbnails. Did you try a `sampler2DArray` for the texture cache?

webgl-page-transitions-with-threejs.author: amina.codes
webgl-page-transitions-with-threejs.body: Love that the reduced-motion fallback is part of the article and not an afterthought. **More of this please.**

webgl-page-transitions-with-threejs.author: maraellison
webgl-page-transitions-with-threejs.body: @jonas-kl not yet — the cache rarely holds more than three textures, so separate samplers are simpler. Might be worth it for a gallery though!

core-web-vitals-for-creative-websites.author: pedro.dev
core-web-vitals-for-creative-websites.body: The Lighthouse CI budget snippet is going straight into our repo. Do you run it on every preview deploy?

core-web-vitals-for-creative-websites.author: maraellison
core-web-vitals-for-creative-websites.body: Yes — on every PR preview, plus a nightly run against production with field data from `web-vitals`.

designing-a-motion-system.author: lena.motion
designing-a-motion-system.body: Four durations and three curves is such a good constraint. We had **nineteen** easing curves in Figma before this.

designing-a-motion-system.author: rafa_ui
designing-a-motion-system.body: The video breakdown makes the spring vs. ease-out difference really obvious. Great player, too!

astro-or-nextjs-for-content-sites.author: kai.builds
astro-or-nextjs-for-content-sites.body: "Split by section, not by page" is the clearest framing of this debate I've read.

generative-music-with-the-web-audio-api.author: synthwave_sam
generative-music-with-the-web-audio-api.body: Decaying noise as an impulse response is such a neat hack. Tried it — sounds lovely with a low-pass on the wet signal.

json-ld-structured-data-recipes.author: seo-nora
json-ld-structured-data-recipes.body: Stable `@id`s saved me from so many duplicate-entity warnings. Bookmarked.

accessible-custom-cursors.author: ada.a11y
accessible-custom-cursors.body: Thank you for the *never hide the cursor over text inputs* rule. So many portfolios get this wrong.
